items.headline: Amateur astronomers use Codex and Astra to identify exoplanet candidates
items.summary: Two amateur astronomers applied Codex and Astra to public Kepler and TESS data, finding potential exoplanets.
items.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how accessible AI tools can aid scientific discovery.
items.evidence_quote: See how two amateur astronomers used Codex and Astra to find potential exoplanets in public data from NASA’s Kepler and TESS space telescopes.

items.headline: Dot Aria assists research and proposal building while flagging messages
items.summary: Marina Petrova’s dot Aria helps research websites, build proposals, and proactively flags messages and resolves issues.
items.why_it_matters: Offers automated support for information gathering and workflow management.
items.evidence_quote: Marina Petrova’s dot Aria helps research websites and build proposals, while proactively flagging messages and resolving issues.

items.headline: Google makes Workspace MCP servers and CLI generally available
items.summary: Google Workspace introduces generally available MCP servers and a Workspace CLI, enabling developers to connect AI agents to Google apps without custom code.
items.why_it_matters: Simplifies building and scaling AI‑driven workflows while keeping organisational data under control.
items.evidence_quote: We are making Workspace Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and the official Workspace CLI generally available.

items.headline: GPT‑6.2 Astra identifies creator of 1808 sketchbook in Yale library
items.summary: GPT‑6.2 Astra autonomously identified the creator of an anonymous 1808 sketchbook at Yale’s Beinecke Library, locating a supporting diary reference.
items.why_it_matters: Shows AI’s potential to accelerate historical research using public sources.
items.evidence_quote: GPT 6.2 Astra was able to autonomously identify the creator of an anonymous 1808 sketchbook held at Yale’s Beinecke Library.

items.headline: Gemini Notebook adds image‑rich flashcards, stopwatch and study reminders
items.summary: Gemini Notebook now offers flashcards with automatic images, a built‑in stopwatch for timed review, and mobile reminders to support consistent study routines.
items.why_it_matters: Enhances active learning tools for students and corporate training.
items.evidence_quote: We introduced three updates to flashcards in Gemini Notebook to help users better retain information.

items.headline: Google Gemini partners with Golden State Warriors for fan and business AI
items.summary: Google Gemini will power fan experiences and business operations for the Warriors, Valkyries and Chase Center.
items.why_it_matters: Brings AI‑driven interaction to sports venues, improving engagement and operations.
items.evidence_quote: Google Gemini partners with Golden State to power fan experiences and business operations for the Warriors, Valkyries, and Chase Center.
